description: This file defines an XHTML 1.1 presentation module for the HTMLPurifier library, including setup of presentation-related HTML elements such as 'hr', 'sub', 'sup', 'b', 'big', 'i', 'small', and 'tt'.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Presentation
classes.description: A class extending HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule that sets up presentation-oriented HTML elements with specific properties.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the module by defining various HTML elements related to presentation, such as 'hr', 'sub', 'sup', 'b', 'big', 'i', 'small', and 'tt', along with their attributes.
